Conflict: The Chef demands the ability to mark items as "Sold Out" instantly to stop incoming orders. However, IT states the kitchen Wi-Fi is terrible and the Kitchen Display System (KDS) might go offline for up to 10 minutes. If the KDS is offline, the Chef's "Sold Out" command cannot sync to the cloud, meaning students will continue ordering out-of-stock items on their phones.

Proposed Resolution: Implement an automatic "Ordering Pause" fail-safe. If the central server detects that the kitchen KDS has been offline for more than 30 to 60 seconds, the mobile app must automatically suspend new orders and display a "Live ordering temporarily paused" banner until the kitchen's connection is restored.
